question: On a graph-authored stdlib-only distributed shared-WAL plain-HTTP substrate (3 worker processes sharing one SQLite WAL at /tmp/spider-graph-36302977302/shared.db with wal_autocheckpoint=0 behind one stdlib round-robin proxy; stable-header representation; HMAC-SHA256 recomputed per auth_state on every request; real If-None-Match/ETag 304; X-Worker-Pid spread verified by cross-worker read-after-write), and using only the four drift families the Director named - F1 auth/session-token rotation, F2 endpoint parameter and header mutation, F3 permission-boundary change, F4 conditional-request revalidation - does the frozen response-derived freshness guard A-CANDIDATE (four channels C1 postcondition_reverify, C2 precondition/auth-context reverify, C3 transport-validator, C4 structure-signature; stale = OR of the four; four-level response-derived confidence map 0.95/0.92/0.85/0.60) reach the preregistered operating point pooled over 180 stale (45 per family) and 720 fresh (240 stable + 480 benign same-channel counterparts, 120 each) items at pi_stale = 0.20, namely true-negative rate >= 0.85 with Wilson lower > 0.75, false-accept <= 0.10 with Wilson upper < 0.1525, UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85, and global plus per-class ECE <= 0.15 with bootstrap 97.5% upper <= 0.18, at MDE_FA 0.165, MDE_TN 0.883, MDE_UNKNOWN_PRECISION 0.911, against B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY, the incumbent C3-or-C4 guard, and single-channel ablations; and, scored as its own arm rather than folded into the guard, does B-FRESH-REDERIVE (empty registry, live re-derivation) obtain the post-drift object at its own measured success and measured request/byte/millisecond cost, so that the guard's economic admissibility is decided by a measured break-even abstention rate u* = (R-1)/R rather than assumed?
hypothesis: H1 (bounded, positive): SPIDER's response-derived freshness guard is a real staleness detector and not a re-description of the drift it was written for, and it is economically admissible at the measured operating point. Specifically, on the graph-authored distributed shared-WAL plain-HTTP substrate at the frozen drift matrix, (a) A-CANDIDATE reaches pooled TN >= 0.85 with Wilson lower > 0.75 (n_fresh=720), FA <= 0.10 (n_stale=180), UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85 (n_unknown=204 at the feasibility boundary), global and per-class ECE <= 0.15 with bootstrap 97.5% upper <= 0.18 over at least three realized confidence levels, and at least three of four stale families with per-family FA Wilson upper < 0.20; (b) the same 480 benign same-channel counterpart items produce abstention at a rate low enough that the guard path request count 1 + u*R is at or below the re-derivation path R, i.e. measured u <= measured u* = (R-1)/R; (c) A-CANDIDATE is strictly better than B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY (FA delta >= 0.15) AND strictly better than the incumbent C3-or-C4 guard on at least one mandated family, AND at least three of the four single-channel ablations are provably decision-distinct from A-CANDIDATE. H0 (bounded, negative): with health gate, drift reachability, null controls, honesty gates and the ablations all valid, A-CANDIDATE fails at least one of (a) or (b) or (c) - that is, the guard misses stale inherited knowledge, or it abstains so often that re-derivation dominates it on every measured cost basis, or the incumbent single/dual-channel signal set already carries all of the value. H0 is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for product use of this guard at this operating point on this substrate; it does not close the C-FRESHNESS domain and does not reject re-derivation or caching. The prior's asymmetry is stated up front: a failure of (a) is a safety negative, a failure of (b) alone is an economic negative that leaves the safety result intact, and the packet is designed so those two are separable.
falsifier: A-CANDIDATE is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (valid scientific negative, status=COMPLETE) if and only if ALL of the following hold first: (G1) M-HEALTH-GATE-PASS is true with M-N-DISTINCT-WORKER-PID >= 2, M-CROSS-WORKER-VISIBILITY true, M-WAL-JOURNAL-MODE='wal', M-REAL-304-COUNT >= 30, M-HMAC-AUTH-VERIFIED true; (G2) drift-matrix reachability is verified by the injector's own assertion plus an independent post-hoc ground-truth check for at least 3 of 4 stale families and at least 3 of 4 benign counterpart families, and every not-reached family's metric is null with the recorded exact smallest next action rather than substituted; (G3) every control PASS-or-FAIL was actually evaluated, with PC-UNPERTURBED-INHERITANCE and PC-PLANTED-BREAK-DETECTED and PC-CONDITIONAL-304-HONEST all executed, NC-BENIGN-COUNTERPART-IMMUNITY evaluated on the 480 benign items, NC-PERMUTED-GROUND-TRUTH landing inside its preregistered null band, NC-ABLATION-DECISION-DISTINCTNESS satisfied by at least three of four ablations, NC-ARM-BLIND-SCORE-ORDER and NC-AUTHORSHIP-SEPARATION both verified by executed checks; (G4) M-NONDEGENERATE-INTERVAL-OK is true, meaning at least three distinct confidence levels are realized, at least two within each of the fresh and stale classes, the ECE bootstrap CI width > 0.002, and the UNKNOWN-precision bootstrap CI width > 0.002; (G5) M-ARM-BLIND-SCORE-ORDER-OK, M-AUTHORSHIP-SEPARATION-OK, M-NO-HARDCODED-OUTCOME-OK are true. AND ANY of: (F1) M-TN-SPIDER < 0.85 OR M-TN-WILSON-LOWER <= 0.75; (F2) M-FA-SPIDER > 0.10 OR M-FA-WILSON-UPPER >= 0.1525; (F3) M-UNKNOWN-PRECISION-SPIDER < 0.85; (F4) M-ECE-GLOBAL > 0.15 OR M-ECE-BOOTSTRAP-UPPER-975 > 0.18 OR M-ECE-FRESH > 0.15 OR M-ECE-STALE > 0.15; (F5) M-UNKNOWN-RATE-PATIENT > 0.85 OR M-UNKNOWN-RATE-PATIENT <= 0.15, i.e. the guard is non-selective; (F6) reached per-family FA exceeds 0.20 Wilson upper for at least two of the four mandated families; (F7) M-GUARD-PATH-REQUESTS-F10 > M-REDERIVE-PATH-REQUESTS-F10 measured in requests, bytes and milliseconds, i.e. the guard path is not cheaper than re-derivation at the measured amortization point; (F8) M-FA-B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY - M-FA-A-CANDIDATE < 0.15, i.e. the guard is not distinguishable from replaying without a guard; (F9) M-FA-B-INCUMBENT-GUARD <= M-FA-A-CANDIDATE + 0.02 AND M-TN-B-INCUMBENT-GUARD >= M-TN-A-CANDIDATE - 0.02, i.e. the two added channels buy nothing on the mandated matrix. NOT a falsification and NOT reachable: any of G1-G5 false (that is MEASUREMENT_INVALID or BLOCKED, never falsification, per research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 1 and section 9); the two non-gated auxiliary probes X1-VALIDATOR-LIE under either revalidation policy (declared before freeze, never scored as a gate, because a lying validator with unchanged field-shape is a declared joint blind spot of any revalidation-based guard); the economic branch failing while the safety branch passes (that is a bounded economic negative, coded as MIXED with decision=FALSIFIES_ECONOMIC_ONLY, not as a safety falsification).

baselines.description: The product decision this claim must beat: replay the inherited mechanism with no guard at all, always EXECUTABLE when preconditions and required slots are present, no revalidation request. Executed on all 900 items with the identical ground truth and identical cost instrumentation.
baselines.expected: M-FA-B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY must be materially higher than M-FA-A-CANDIDATE by >= 0.15 and M-TN-B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY must equal 1.0 (it never abstains). CAPABLE OF FAILING for the guard contrast: if it does not exceed the candidate by 0.15 the candidate has no discriminative value and F8 fires.

baselines.description: The signal set actually used by the three prior graph C-FRESHNESS positives (EXP-GRAPH-35940399935, EXP-GRAPH-35947468747, EXP-GRAPH-36018188168) evaluated on THIS drift matrix: C3 transport-validator (status, ETag change, Cache-Control weakening) OR C4 structure-signature (field-path/type Jaccard < 0.85 on the required-filtered token set, endpoint template equality), threshold 0.85 inherited unchanged, confidence 0.95 fresh / 0.85 stale as previously recalibrated. Provably a strict subset of A-CANDIDATE's channel set, hence decision-distinct by construction whenever C1 or C2 fires alone.
baselines.expected: Structurally blind to F1 auth/session-token rotation on the 'old token still valid' sub-case and to the F3 permission-boundary sub-cases where the error envelope keeps the same field-path/type token set, so per-family FA on F1 and F3 must exceed 0.10 and the pooled FA must be at least 0.05 higher than the candidate's. This is the arm that decides whether the two added channels earn their keep.

baselines.description: Single-channel ablation C1 only: stale = NOT kernel._matches(mechanism.postconditions, live_body). Strict subset of A-CANDIDATE; cannot fire on any item where the body is unchanged but the binding is invalid.
baselines.expected: FA materially above 0.10 on F1 and F3; must be decision-distinct from A-CANDIDATE on at least one item (NC-ABLATION-DECISION-DISTINCTNESS).

baselines.description: Single-channel ablation C2 only: stale = NOT kernel._matches(mechanism.preconditions UNION applicability_guards, live_auth_context) where live_auth_context is recomputed from the HMAC-SHA256-verified auth_state plus the resource's required scope.
baselines.expected: FA materially above 0.10 on F2 and F4; must be decision-distinct from A-CANDIDATE.

baselines.description: Single-channel ablation C3 only: stale = (status != 200) OR (etag_cached is not None AND etag_live != etag_cached) OR cache-control weakened. Strict subset of A-CANDIDATE.
baselines.expected: FA materially above 0.10 on the F4 sub-case where the server keeps a stable-subset ETag and unchanged field-shape; must be decision-distinct.

baselines.description: Single-channel ablation C4 only: stale = (jaccard(field-path/type tokens cached, live) < 0.85) OR endpoint template inequality, threshold 0.85 inherited unchanged. Strict subset of A-CANDIDATE.
baselines.expected: FA materially above 0.10 on F1 and F3; must be decision-distinct.

baselines.description: ARM B, scored as its own arm and never folded into the guard: empty registry, no inherited mechanism, live re-derivation of the same object from the current responses, then execution and deterministic postcondition verification. Executed on the same 900 items with the same ground truth and the same cost instrumentation. Its inherited-knowledge stale-accept rate is a STRUCTURAL property, not a measurement: it holds no inherited knowledge, so M-REDERIVE-STALE-ACCEPT is null with a declared reason and is explicitly NOT recorded as 0.0. The measured quantities are M-REDERIVE-SUCCESS, M-REDERIVE-PATH-REQUESTS, M-REDERIVE-PATH-WIRE-BYTES and M-REDERIVE-PATH-WALLCLOCK-MS.
baselines.expected: Success near the achievable ceiling on this substrate; the decision-relevant output is R = its measured per-item request count, from which the break-even abstention rate u* = (R-1)/R is computed. CAPABLE OF FAILING: if re-derivation cannot reconstruct the post-drift object on some family at a success rate the guard path also cannot reach, that is a real negative for BOTH arms and is reported as such.

baselines.description: Full cold re-exploration with an empty registry: three discovery observations per resource before any execution. The expensive reference that bounds what re-derivation is worth and what inheritance could ever save.
baselines.expected: Highest request count and wall clock of all arms; used only to bound the amortization range, never as a competitor to inheritance.

positive_control: PC-UNPERTURBED-INHERITANCE: 60 items on which the injected plan is the no-op, valid auth, in-scope permission, honest validator, unmutated template. Expected: EXECUTABLE on 60/60, verification true on 60/60, cost exactly one revalidation request, abstention 0. CAN FAIL: it fails if the guard over-abstains on a healthy inheritance, which is the guard's most expensive failure mode and the one no prior packet in this thread could detect. PC-PLANTED-BREAK-DETECTED: 30 items on which the injector asserts a known break of a declared family and the independent post-hoc ground-truth check confirms the label; expected flagged UNKNOWN on 30/30. CAN FAIL: it fails if the guard misses a break the injector can prove, which is the guard's most dangerous failure mode. PC-CONDITIONAL-304-HONEST: 30 items on which the server's validator is honest and the conditional GET returns a real 304 with an unchanged body; expected EXECUTABLE on 30/30 and the cached value must verify. CAN FAIL: if the guard treats an honest 304 as evidence of staleness it fails. All three positive controls are EXECUTED against the live substrate with per-item logs, are scored with the same code path as the primary, and any failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the instrument is not adjudicated), never a scientific negative.
null_control: NC-BENIGN-COUNTERPART-IMMUNITY: the mandatory null control, and it is the one that CAN fire by construction because every one of its 480 items perturbs the same observable channel as its stale counterpart and differs only in whether the inherited knowledge remains valid. B1 benign token re-issue inside the server's overlap/grace window (new token string, recomputed auth_state HMAC, old stored token still executes 200); B2 benign endpoint-template extension (a new optional query param and a new optional response header, stored template still satisfies the endpoint); B3 benign permission noise on a resource the mechanism never touches plus 30 genuine 403s on /api/permission/{id} while the target resource stays 200; B4 benign conditional revalidation (honest 304 with an unchanged ETag, plus 30 items where the ETag changed and the revalidation 200 body is content-identical). Expected: abstention on at most 10 percent pooled and at most 20 percent per counterpart family, otherwise the null control has fired and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This is the exact defect class the prior packets could not test: EXP-GRAPH-35940399935, EXP-GRAPH-35947468747 and EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 achieved NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA=0.0 by a required-path filter that excluded the very fields the noise touched, which their own audits recorded as satisfiable by construction. Secondary nulls, all executed: NC-PERMUTED-GROUND-TRUTH (the ground-truth label is permuted 1000 times at the family level and the discriminative association of A-CANDIDATE's decision with the label must land inside the preregistered null band, proving the scoring code has power); NC-ABLATION-DECISION-DISTINCTNESS (at least three of the four single-channel ablations must produce at least one decision that differs from A-CANDIDATE on the 900 items; an ablation with zero differing decisions is declared INVALID rather than scored, and if fewer than three are distinct the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID - the exact defect that made the reference arm in EXP-GRAPH-36287167610 provably identical to its candidate); NC-ARM-BLIND-SCORE-ORDER (the detector writes and hashes its arm-blind output before the arm-label file is created, and the label join runs afterwards); NC-AUTHORSHIP-SEPARATION (the ground-truth injector module and the detector/scorer module are separate files, the detector's source contains no reference to the injector module, and the runner aborts the packet if the separation is violated); NC-NO-HARDCODED-OUTCOME (every guard decision is recomputed from the logged raw HTTP exchange, and a replay of the scorer over the raw log reproduces every decision bit-identically).
measurement_validity: V1-SUBSTRATE-HEALTH-GATE: before any outcome measurement, the runner must record M-HEALTH-GATE-PASS with M-N-DISTINCT-WORKER-PID >= 2 observed across at least 60 responses, M-CROSS-WORKER-VISIBILITY true (a write committed by worker A is read by worker B within the same probe window), M-WAL-JOURNAL-MODE='wal', M-REAL-304-COUNT >= 30 honest 304s, M-HMAC-AUTH-VERIFIED true, M-PROXY-ROUNDROBIN-SPREAD >= 2. Any failure is BLOCKED or MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the exact smallest next action, never falsification.

V2-DRIFT-MATRIX-REACHABILITY: every stale and benign item is reachable only if the injector's own plan record asserts it AND an independent post-hoc check confirms the ground-truth label from the WAL/injector ledger rather than from any response content. Unreached families are reported with null metrics and the recorded smallest next action; they are never substituted. Primary requires at least 3 of 4 stale and at least 3 of 4 benign families reached.

V3-AUTHORSHIP-AND-ARBITRATION-SEPARATION: the intervention surface and its auth/session boundary live in a module separate from the detector and scorer; the detector receives only the live HTTP exchange; the arm label is joined only after the detector output file is written and hashed. This is the contract EXP-RUNTIME-36293257855 was supposed to generalize and which failed non-retryably (execute exit code 76, failure.json fingerprint 32fb61131a26107aaf831564, run 36293257855), so the confound is broken locally by executed, machine-checked construction rather than inherited as a result.

V4-ARM-BLIND-SCORING: detector_output.jsonl is written and sha256-recorded before the arm-label file exists; M-ARM-BLIND-SCORE-ORDER-OK records both the hash and the file creation order. This is adopted as an executed design property from the certified contract at research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-36129163700/artifacts/A-SEEDED-ORDER.json (source_ref origin/lab2/runtime, source_ref_head e685fb1eea8d506cafb1c2afdeff746ce9e41e52, verdict.json sha256 ea5f80f07442ef6b510f0b3d1814a5032d7b53947098b3f704d8f3186791579e), not as an inherited measurement.

V5-NO-FITTED-PARAMETERS: A-CANDIDATE, every ablation, the threshold 0.85 and the four-level confidence map 0.95/0.92/0.85/0.60 are all pre-declared in the preregistration and frozen before execution. No quantity is selected, tuned or re-thresholded after any outcome is visible, and no train/validation split exists because nothing is fitted; the two disjoint resource-halves stability check (M-HALF-SPLIT-*) exists to catch a result driven by one resource family, not to select anything.

V6-NON-DEGENERATE-INTERVALS: every primary gate uses a Wilson interval, which is non-degenerate by construction. The auxiliary bootstrap (2000 resamples, stratified by stratum x family, percentile) is used only for M-ECE-BOOTSTRAP-UPPER-975 and the reported widths, and a bootstrap interval of width 0 is declared DEGENERATE and may not satisfy any gate. M-NONDEGENERATE-INTERVAL-OK additionally requires at least three distinct realized confidence levels overall and at least two within each of the fresh and stale classes, ECE bootstrap width > 0.002 and UNKNOWN-precision bootstrap width > 0.002. This directly targets the defect the prior three graph packets recorded: EXP-GRAPH-35947468747's bootstrap was [1.0,1.0] and [0.0,0.0] and its ECE was satisfiable by construction from a two-point recalibration.

V7-ECE-ATTAINABILITY-AND-NON-TAUTOLOGY: the confidence level is a pre-declared function of which channels fire, never a hand-assigned branch value, and ECE is measured against the injector's ground truth rather than against the guard's own output. Attainability arithmetic frozen in prereg.md section 10: if every decision is correct the global ECE is 0.0915 at the expected level mix and stays <= 0.126 for any mix with <= 0.30 mass at confidence 0.60, so the 0.15 target has real headroom; and the gate has real power, since a level-0.85 bin with accuracy 0.50 at mass 0.40 alone yields 0.1715 and a fresh bin with 0.20 false negatives at mass 0.40 yields 0.124. The realized mass at confidence <= 0.60 is preregistered: if it exceeds 0.20 the calibration arm is reported INCONCLUSIVE_BY_LEVEL_MIX with that reason, never re-tuned.

V8-ECONOMIC-COST-BASIS: the cost basis is measured and program-independent - HTTP request count, wire bytes in both directions, and wall-clock milliseconds per episode - all logged from the real exchange. No abstract unit, no token count, no experimenter-assigned ledger. This is a deliberate response to the EXP-FRONTIER-36287182510 finding that an experimenter-assigned three-term abstract-unit ledger produced a decision-grade-looking result with no external cost basis. Consequence stated up front: this is not a token-economic result and must not be read as one, because CAP-POLICY-MODEL-CREDENTIAL is UNAVAILABLE in the certified ledger.

V9-PREVALENCE-AND-POWER: pi_stale is preregistered at 0.20 with n_stale=180 and n_fresh=720, and the exact minimum detectable effects are frozen at FA 0.165129 (n=180, one-sided exact binomial, alpha 0.05, power 0.80, rejection at >= 26/180), TN 0.882946 (n=720, rejection at >= 629/720), UNKNOWN precision 0.911151 (n=204, rejection at >= 183/204) and per-family FA 0.243264 (n=45, rejection at >= 9/45). Declared accept-side Wilson boundaries: FA 0/180 upper 0.0209, 18/180 upper 0.1525, TN 720/720 lower 0.9947, 684/720 lower 0.9316, UNKNOWN precision 180/204 = 0.8824 lower 0.8309. MDEs are quoted to six decimals because the four-decimal roundings of 0.1651 and 0.8829 fall a few units below the true MDE; all four rejection rules are conservative (alpha 0.0362, 0.0402, 0.0326, 0.0320 at their nulls) and there is no sequential testing, no optional stopping and no outcome-dependent adaptation. Bootstrap sanity at the ideal point, 2000 stratified resamples over 900 items: ECE point 0.070, 97.5% upper 0.0727, width 0.0052, comfortably inside the 0.18 bound and non-degenerate.

V10-JOINT-OPERATING-POINT-FEASIBILITY: the guard must satisfy TN >= 0.85 and UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85 simultaneously, and the two are a joint requirement, not two independent ones. Solving TP/(TP+FN_fresh) >= 0.85 for FN_fresh <= 0.17647*TP with n_stale=180 and n_fresh=720: at TP=153 (85% detection) FN_fresh <= 27 so TN >= 0.9625; at TP=180 (perfect detection) FN_fresh <= 31 so TN >= 0.9569. The pair is attainable (TN=1, TP=180 gives precision 1.0) and genuinely falsifiable (TN=0.85 with TP=153 gives 153 unknown out of 261 and precision 0.586, which fails), so a high abstention rate is not a safe fallback. The exact boundary arithmetic is frozen in prereg.md section 10; at execute time this condition is recomputed on the REALIZED counts, so a marginal pass is distinguishable from a comfortable one, and the safety and calibration failure directions are reported separately so neither can hide inside the other.

V11-ABLATION-DISTINCTNESS-IS-COMPUTED-NOT-ASSERTED: each single-channel ablation is a strict subset of the candidate's channel set, and the number of items on which each ablation's decision differs from the candidate's is computed over all 900 items and reported as M-DISTINCT-ITEMS-B-*. An ablation with zero differing decisions is declared INVALID and is not scored, because a comparison against an arm that is provably identical to the candidate tests no gate.

V12-REPRESENTATION-LOSS-DISCLOSURE: the substrate is plain HTTP with flat JSON bodies. There is no HTML DOM, no CSSOM, no accessibility tree and no JavaScript execution, so channel C4 is a field-path/type token signature and a server-signaled endpoint template, NOT a DOM signature, and the prior graph packets' 'dom_drift' family name is not reused here because it would misrepresent what was measured. The guard cannot see drift that leaves field-shape, headers, status, validator and the mechanism's own postcondition all unchanged. Token 16-hex ETag truncation, value magnitudes, nested depth and query-parameter value semantics are all discarded, and the X1-VALIDATOR-LIE probe is the declared measurement of that blind spot.

V13-RAW-EVIDENCE-AND-RECOMPUTABILITY: every request logs the full request line, headers, body, status, ETag, Cache-Control, X-Worker-Pid, upstream port, the four channel outcomes, the decision, the confidence level, the ground-truth plan reference and a per-row sha256. The detector decision for every one of the 900 items is recomputable from the raw log alone by a scorer that shares no code with the injector, and M-NO-HARDCODED-OUTCOME-OK records that replay agreeing on 900/900.

V14-NO-CODE-DIGEST-GATE: standing control-plane condition from the Director mandate. No frozen gate in this packet requires a code digest or a code-bound attestation, because scripts/freeze_experiment.py hashes exactly request.json, spec.json and prereg.md and scripts/check_scope.py:124-127 gives stage 'design' prefixes=[] with exact={spec.json, prereg.md, failure.json, model_design.json}, which made the inherited condition EXP-GRAPH-36287167610/V9-CODE-BOUND-VIA-PREREG unsatisfiable in every lane and produced three consecutive measurement-invalid Graph packets. That inherited id is namespaced by its experiment because THIS packet's own V9 is V9-PREVALENCE-AND-POWER, a different condition; the two must not be conflated. The binding that is used instead is the executed health gate in V1, which measures the substrate rather than attesting a file.

V15-DEPENDENCY-HONESTY: two mandated dependencies are recorded as unmet and are handled by declared scope exclusion with an exact smallest next action each, never by substitution. (i) Runtime's authorship/transport generalization of the intervention oracle did not land: EXP-RUNTIME-36293257855 is not in codex/index.json, is absent from research/experiments/ on this branch, and closed at execute with failure.json stage=execute category=EXECUTION_FAILURE message='stage exited with code 76' retryable=false fingerprint=32fb61131a26107aaf831564 github_run_id=36293257855. (ii) The public-API Chromium DOM/AX write path is not intervention-valid: CAP-CHROMIUM-LAUNCH is AVAILABLE in the certified ledger but the browser write leg has no durable WAL record and EXP-RUNTIME-36129163700's own handoff records the browser_B scope as 'satisfied as a launch fact and unsatisfied as an intervention-validity fact'. No browser arm is engaged, and no substitute transport is used.

V16-METRIC-IDENTITY-ALIASES: two names in this packet denote one quantity and are declared equivalent so that EXECUTE and AUDIT cannot silently split them. M-TN-A-CANDIDATE is an alias of M-TN-SPIDER (pooled true-negative rate of the candidate guard A-CANDIDATE over the 720 fresh items) and M-FA-A-CANDIDATE is an alias of M-FA-SPIDER (pooled false-accept rate of A-CANDIDATE over the 180 stale items). The alias form appears in falsifier and decision_rule because those clauses name the arm; the canonical form appears in prereg.md section 9. result.json must report the canonical form and may additionally carry the alias, but it must never report two different numbers for the same quantity. The wildcard forms M-HALF-SPLIT-* and M-DISTINCT-ITEMS-B-* in this file are expanded in prereg.md section 9 into the exact identities M-HALF-SPLIT-TN-A, M-HALF-SPLIT-TN-B, M-HALF-SPLIT-FA-A, M-HALF-SPLIT-FA-B and M-DISTINCT-ITEMS-B-POSTCOND-ONLY, M-DISTINCT-ITEMS-B-PERMISSION-ONLY, M-DISTINCT-ITEMS-B-VALIDATOR-ONLY, M-DISTINCT-ITEMS-B-STRUCTURE-ONLY; the expansion introduces no new quantity. Two further identity facts are declared here so the apparent spec/prereg asymmetry is not mistaken for a defect. (a) INVENTORY: the canonical, complete metric inventory of this packet is prereg.md section 9, which is hashed by the freezer alongside this file; the M-ids appearing inline in this spec are a non-exhaustive subset consisting only of the metrics referenced by falsifier, decision_rule or the V-conditions, and no metric in prereg.md section 9 is a new quantity invented after freeze. (b) X1: X1-VALIDATOR-LIE and X1-VALIDATOR-LIE-304 denote the same single non-gated auxiliary probe, whose outcomes are M-X1-DETECTION-POLICY-CONDITIONAL and M-X1-DETECTION-POLICY-UNCONDITIONAL; the two names are not two probes.
decision_rule: Gate order is frozen and short-circuits; a false validity gate is NEVER reported as a scientific negative. GATE 0 - preconditions and validity: G1 M-HEALTH-GATE-PASS true; G2 M-ARM-BLIND-SCORE-ORDER-OK, M-AUTHORSHIP-SEPARATION-OK, M-NO-HARDCODED-OUTCOME-OK all true; G3 M-NONDEGENERATE-INTERVAL-OK true; G4 drift reachability >= 3 of 4 stale and >= 3 of 4 benign families; G5 all seven controls actually evaluated, with PC-UNPERTURBED-INHERITANCE, PC-PLANTED-BREAK-DETECTED and PC-CONDITIONAL-304-HONEST all PASS and NC-BENIGN-COUNTERPART-IMMUNITY abstention <= 0.10 pooled and <= 0.20 per family, NC-PERMUTED-GROUND-TRUTH inside its band, and at least 3 of 4 ablations decision-distinct. If any of G1-G5 is false: result.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (or BLOCKED if the substrate itself could not be brought up), outcome=INCONCLUSIVE, no claim-level statement, and each false gate carries the exact smallest next action. GATE 1 - the frozen accept branch, reached only if GATE 0 fully passes: SUPPORTS iff ALL of A1 TN >= 0.85 with M-TN-WILSON-LOWER > 0.75; A2 FA <= 0.10 with M-FA-WILSON-UPPER < 0.1525; A3 UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85; A4 M-ECE-GLOBAL <= 0.15 and M-ECE-FRESH <= 0.15 and M-ECE-STALE <= 0.15 and M-ECE-BOOTSTRAP-UPPER-975 <= 0.18; A5 selectivity M-UNKNOWN-RATE-PATIENT in (0.15, 0.85]; A6 per-family FA Wilson upper < 0.20 for every reached family; A7 M-FA-B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY - M-FA-A-CANDIDATE >= 0.15; A8 economic admissibility M-GUARD-PATH-REQUESTS-F10 <= M-REDERIVE-PATH-REQUESTS-F10 and M-UNKNOWN-RATE-PATIENT <= U-BREAKEVEN; A9 discriminative value over the incumbent, M-FA-B-INCUMBENT-GUARD > M-FA-A-CANDIDATE + 0.02 or M-TN-B-INCUMBENT-GUARD < M-TN-A-CANDIDATE - 0.02. FALSIFIES iff GATE 0 passed and ANY of F1-F9 in spec.json.falsifier holds. MIXED in exactly two preregistered ways: (i) F7 fires while F1-F6 and F8-F9 pass, coded as outcome=MIXED with decision=FALSIFIES_ECONOMIC_ONLY, meaning the safety result stands and the product decision is that re-derivation dominates the guard on this substrate; (ii) A1-A4 pass and the realized confidence mass at level <= 0.60 exceeds 0.20, coded as outcome=MIXED with decision=CALIBRATION_INCONCLUSIVE_BY_LEVEL_MIX, meaning the safety result stands and the frozen confidence map cannot express confidence for the observed evidence pattern; the map is NOT re-tuned. INCONCLUSIVE only when the primary interval straddles a threshold with a width above 0.20 at the frozen n, which the MDE arithmetic in V9 makes a narrow band. NOT_APPLICABLE is used only if the substrate cannot be brought up at all. The two auxiliary probes X1-VALIDATOR-LIE-304 under POLICY-CONDITIONAL and POLICY-UNCONDITIONAL are reported for every run under every verdict and gate nothing.
product_consequence_positive: If GATE 0 passes and A1-A9 all hold, the bounded claim C-FRESHNESS moves from HYPOTHESIS to EXPERIMENTAL at exactly this ceiling: a response-derived four-channel guard detects stale inherited knowledge on a distributed shared-WAL plain-HTTP substrate across session/token rotation, endpoint parameter and header mutation, permission-boundary change and conditional-request revalidation, at TN >= 0.85 (Wilson lower > 0.75), FA <= 0.10, UNKNOWN precision >= 0.85 and global/per-class ECE <= 0.15 with bootstrap upper <= 0.18, at a measured abstention rate at or below the measured break-even u*, on 900 items, one substrate, one seed, one run, no LLM, no browser, no external site. Consequences: (1) the product kernel may expose freshness as an UNKNOWN-before-execute gate with the four named channels rather than shipping replay-by-default, and the product answer for an uncertain inheritance becomes UNKNOWN plus re-derivation, which the architecture already prefers; (2) C-DELTA-REPAIR's preregistered prerequisite of a calibrated freshness guard is answered at EXPERIMENTAL level, so the next delta-repair cycle may use the C1/C2 channels for localized re-binding without re-measuring detection; (3) the frozen revalidation policy question is answered by the measured X1 cost delta, so the product cache policy is chosen from a measurement instead of a default. This does NOT promote to VALIDATED, does NOT authorize PRODUCT_CORE, and does NOT extend to any real website, any real browser, any LLM agent or any token economics; those remain gated on the recorded smallest next actions.
product_consequence_negative: Three bounded negatives are possible and each has a different product consequence. (i) SAFETY NEGATIVE, F1-F6 or F8-F9 with GATE 0 passing: SPIDER cannot say 'this inherited knowledge is still true' at a bounded false-accept rate on this substrate with this signal set. The product must then default to re-derivation plus caching, must not ship a replay path on the assumption of a guard, and the freshness-guard architecture must be re-derived at a different level of description rather than re-thresholded, because the threshold is not the binding constraint. C-FRESHNESS stays at HYPOTHESIS with a bounded falsification recorded; the domain is not closed. (ii) ECONOMIC NEGATIVE, F7 alone: the guard is safe enough but abstains so often that 1 + u*R > R, so the guard is a pure cost. The product consequence is concrete and favourable to the simplest architecture: do not ship the guard as a mechanism; ship re-derivation with response caching, and revisit guarding only where R is small relative to 1, that is where re-derivation is expensive. Safety evidence from the same run is preserved and explicitly not withdrawn. (iii) NO INCREMENTAL VALUE, F9: the two added channels buy nothing over the incumbent signal set, so the incumbent guard plus re-derivation is the whole answer and the added channel architecture is not worth its maintenance surface. None of the three authorizes retiring C-FRESHNESS, none authorizes a claim status below its current registry ceiling, and none may be recorded as a rejection of the domain; per research/EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 1 a design or control-plane failure is never encoded as a scientific negative, and a MEASUREMENT_INVALID at GATE 0 authorizes no product change at all.
estimated_cost: Stdlib-only, no pip install, no browser, no docker, no model key, no external network. Substrate: 3 worker processes plus one stdlib round-robin proxy on 127.0.0.1, SQLite WAL at /tmp/spider-graph-36302977302/shared.db. Volume: 900 evaluated items x (candidate 1 conditional request + 5 ablation/incumbent recomputations from the same single exchange + no-guard 0 requests + re-derive 2-4 requests + cold 3 discovery requests) plus 120 positive-control items and 60 X1 items x 2 policies, so roughly 12000-16000 localhost HTTP requests in total. At 1-5 ms per localhost stdlib request the transport cost is under 2 minutes; the 2000-resample stratified bootstrap over 900 rows and the 1000-permutation ground-truth null are a few seconds of pure-Python. Disk: a WAL database well under 50 MB plus a per-row raw JSONL log of order 10-20 MB, written to the experiment's own raw_evidence directory. Total well under 0.5 compute-hour and 0 US dollars of API spend. If the substrate cannot be brought up, cost is the bring-up attempt only and the outcome is BLOCKED or MEASUREMENT_INVALID with the recorded smallest next action.
expected_information_gain: Very high, and higher than any other candidate this cycle, for four reasons that are structural rather than rhetorical. (1) It answers a claim with 61 Codex events whose last state is HYPOTHESIS with a MEASUREMENT_INVALID history, on the substrate Runtime has now certified, and the three prior graph positives (EXP-GRAPH-35940399935, EXP-GRAPH-35947468747, EXP-GRAPH-36018188168) have never been carried through a real drift matrix. (2) Every one of those three packets constructed its drift families out of the guard's own features - required-filtered Jaccard, a server-signaled template, ETag plus max-age - so the positives and the tautology risk are entangled and cannot be separated by re-analysis. This design removes the entanglement at the level of description rather than by tuning: none of the four mandated families is defined by a guard feature, and three of the four are partly or wholly invisible to the incumbent signal set, so the incumbent is carried as a baseline and its per-family blindness becomes a measurement. (3) The prior noise-immunity control could not fire, because the required-path filter excluded the fields the noise touched, and the prior calibration was a two-point recalibration satisfiable by construction; this design makes the null control fire by construction (480 same-channel benign counterparts), uses a four-level response-derived confidence map with a frozen attainability arithmetic, and forbids a bootstrap interval of width 0 from satisfying any gate. (4) It is the only candidate in the portfolio that produces an external cost basis for the architecture question. The one recent valid transaction in the program, EXP-FRONTIER-36287182510, found that an arm retaining nothing between episodes reached perfect correctness and that the only surviving role for persistent state is amortization, which it could not identify because its cost ledger was experimenter-assigned. This design measures request count, wire bytes and wall clock on the real exchange and reduces the guard-versus-re-derivation question to one number, u* = (R-1)/R, against which the measured abstention rate is compared. Either answer changes an architectural decision: if u <= u* the guard is admissible where inheritance has something to protect, and if u > u* the product is re-derivation plus caching and the guard is a liability. A negative is equally valuable because it is the first bounded, valid falsification this claim has ever received.
